name: solana-mcp-server
description: Solana wallets, SOL and SPL token transfers, token minting and authority management, account and transaction lookups across devnet, testnet and mainnet.

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create a new Solana wallet

tools.name: import_wallet
tools.description: Import an existing wallet from private key or mnemonic

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.description: List all created/imported wallets

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get SOL balance for a wallet

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get SPL token balance for a wallet

tools.name: transfer_sol
tools.description: Transfer SOL between wallets

tools.name: transfer_tokens
tools.description: Transfer SPL tokens between wallets

tools.name: airdrop_sol
tools.description: Request SOL airdrop for testing (devnet/testnet only)

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Get detailed account information

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get transaction details by signature

tools.name: get_recent_blockhash
tools.description: Get recent blockhash for transaction building

tools.name: switch_network
tools.description: Switch Solana network

tools.name: get_network_info
tools.description: Get current network information

tools.name: create_token_account
tools.description: Create associated token account for SPL tokens

tools.name: get_token_accounts
tools.description: Get all token accounts for a wallet

tools.name: create_spl_token
tools.description: Create a new SPL token with specified decimals

tools.name: mint_tokens
tools.description: Mint tokens to a specific account

tools.name: burn_tokens
tools.description: Burn tokens from a wallet

tools.name: freeze_account
tools.description: Freeze a token account to prevent transfers

tools.name: thaw_account
tools.description: Thaw a frozen token account to allow transfers

tools.name: set_token_authority
tools.description: Set or change authority for a token mint or account

tools.name: get_token_supply
tools.description: Get the total supply of a token

tools.name: close_token_account
tools.description: Close a token account and reclaim rent

tools.name: approve_delegate
tools.description: Approve a delegate to transfer tokens on your behalf

tools.name: revoke_delegate
tools.description: Revoke a delegate's authority to transfer tokens
